summary: Rent the Runway filed an 8-K disclosing a Rights Offering Backstop Agreement dated September 11, 2026 among the Company, CHS US Investments, Gateway Runway (Nexus) and S3 RR Aggregator (STORY3). The Company will distribute transferable pro rata subscription rights to Class A holders for a $15,000,000 rights offering at a Subscription Price equal to the greater of $3.55 (15-day VWAP through the second trading day prior) or the 15-day VWAP through the record date. The Investor Group backstops all unsubscribed shares. A Form S-1 registration statement is required; closing conditions include effectiveness. Watch subscription uptake, record date, pricing reset, and potential dilution/overhang from backstop shares.
